extensions.name: Excalidraw
extensions.description: Excalidraw drawings in den: a .excalidraw file's Preview is Excalidraw itself, saving each change to the file.

extensions.name: Git Graph
extensions.description: The repository's commits as a graph, with branch and commit actions, like vscode-git-graph.

extensions.name: Slidev
extensions.description: Slidev decks in den: the slides as an outline, a live preview in the browser that follows the cursor, and the dev server one click away.

extensions.name: Task Buttons
extensions.description: The tasks in .vscode/tasks.json as buttons in den's title bar, like VS Code's Tasks extension.

extensions.name: Workspace Stats
extensions.description: Remembers the folders den opens, sums up their languages, and reminds you to take a break.
